item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

Intimate ceremonies in New Zealand's most cinematic places — lakesides, alpine summits, secret beaches and quiet chapels. Curated, calmly orchestrated, photographed beautifully.
An elopement is not a smaller wedding. It's a louder love story, told quietly.

For over a decade we've helped couples from around the world say "I do" in the wild, weather-changing beauty of New Zealand — lakesides veiled in mist, alpine ridges, cathedral coves at low tide, gardens in late bloom.
We handle every thread of the day — the celebrant, the bouquet, the witness, the chopper, the champagne — so the two of you can simply stand still in it.

Intimate ceremonies in Australia's most cinematic places: golden beaches, rainforest clifftops, island sandbars and quiet hinterland chapels. Curated, calmly orchestrated and photographed beautifully.
An elopement is not a smaller wedding. It's a louder love story, told quietly.

For nearly a decade we've helped couples from around the world elope in New Zealand's untamed landscapes. Now we're bringing that experience to Australia's own wild, sun-drenched beauty: headlands wrapped in morning haze, secluded coves at low tide, rainforest edges and gardens in late bloom.
We handle every thread of the day, from the celebrant, bouquet and witness to the chopper and champagne, so the two of you can simply stand still in it.
From a quiet jetty on the Noosa River to a windswept headland above Byron Bay, each destination is curated for a different shade of love. Choose the place and we'll choreograph the rest.

From the first hello to the final toast, every detail is gently held by your dedicated planner. The licence, the legal paperwork, the celebrant, the venue. No spreadsheets, no second-guessing, only presence.

We work with Australia's most quietly extraordinary celebrants, florists, hair and make-up artists, photographers, helicopter pilots and chefs. The kind of people whose names get passed between couples in whispers.

Since 2016, Eloping Weddings has helped couples leave the noise of the big traditional wedding behind and stand still in wild, sun-drenched beauty — first across New Zealand, and now in Australia. Every elopement is thoughtfully designed, calmly run, and beautifully remembered.
Nearly a decade of quiet love.
A landscape that doesn't perform, it remembers.

Australia isn't a backdrop; it's a co-conspirator. From the golden curve of a Sunshine Coast beach to the green hush of the Byron hinterland, this country turns ordinary days into love stories. The air here carries something the rest of the world has misplaced: space, light, the slow drama of the seasons.

For couples drawn to a wedding that feels less like an event and more like a moment carved into the landscape itself, Australia is where it begins. A few of our most-loved ceremonies have happened here: barefoot on a hidden cove at first light, beneath a flowering gum in a quiet hinterland garden, two minutes after the helicopter touched down on a windswept clifftop. The decision is never about choosing 'small'. It's about choosing what matters.
Three ways to say I do in Australia.

Stand together on a still morning at the edge of the ocean, bare feet on warm sand, the horizon wide open before you. We curate intimate ceremonies on secluded stretches of coastline reached only by foot, so you'll never share the view with another soul. Bouquet, celebrant, witnesses and photographer move quietly around you while the sea does what the sea does best.

Late blooms, climbing greenery and an old timber arbour softened by the seasons. Australia's hinterland gardens feel like the storybook version of a vow. We've hand-picked walled gardens and hidden estate lawns just minutes from town, where florals are already part of the scenery and the only soundtrack is birdsong. Perfect for couples who want softness, intimacy and a touch of garden charm.

Minutes after take-off, you're standing somewhere most Australians will never see: a clifftop above the coast, a secluded island sandbar, a hidden valley deep in the hinterland. Just the two of you, your celebrant, your pilot and a photographer who knows how to disappear. A cinematic ceremony with the whole country laid out below, the photograph framed above your fireplace for the next fifty years.
Six quiet reasons couples keep choosing Australia: the geography, the weather, the unspoken privilege of standing somewhere very few people ever stand.
From headlands to hidden coves, Australia's coast frames every ceremony, glowing gold at sunrise and soft rose at dusk.
On calm mornings the bays and inlets mirror the sky so completely you can stand at the water's edge and feel like you're walking on a quiet bowl of clouds.
Australia's warm climate gives us long, generous seasons: blue-sky winters, golden autumns, balmy summers and bloom-thick springs. Every month has a postcard to offer.
Light lingers here, soft and copper, late into the afternoon, long enough for vows, kisses, and a wander before sunset.
We hold quiet relationships with private beaches, jetties and garden estates, small corners of the country reachable only with us.
In season, the coastal heath and hinterland meadows bloom with native wildflowers, an entirely natural ceremony aisle no council could ever plant.
The bay was so still it felt like the world was holding its breath for us.
From the first message in your inbox to the moment your ring catches the morning light over the water, your day moves through four quiet steps. Every detail is held by us, you only have to arrive.
A long, no-pressure conversation about who the two of you are, what you don't want, and the moment you'd quietly choose.
We draft a bespoke sketch with three location options, a celebrant we trust, and a photographer whose work makes you feel something.
Bouquet, licence, witnesses, weather contingencies, the dinner reservation, the surprise. Every thread, carried so you don't have to.
And the day unfolds the way the best days always do: gently, exactly itself, and over far too quickly.
"We came to Australia thinking we'd booked a wedding. What we got was an entire morning of our lives placed gently in someone else's hands, and a photograph we'll grow old underneath."

A curated list of additions our couples reach for most. Each can be added to any package — no awkward conversations, no surprise totals.
What exactly is included in each package?

Every package includes the celebrant, full legal paperwork, two witnesses, a seasonal bouquet, location scouting and a dedicated planner. Each tier adds more — photography hours, cinematography, hair & make-up, helicopter and so on. The Compare table above shows the full breakdown.

Yes, completely. Most of our couples adjust at least one or two elements. Want photography from the Signature tier but a Heli ceremony? Easy. Want a videographer added to the Intimate package? Done. The add-ons list above covers the most common requests, but anything is possible.
How far in advance should we book?

Three to six months is comfortable for most ceremonies. Peak season dates (roughly September to April) book up faster — we'd recommend reaching out as soon as you have a rough date in mind. We've also held intimate ceremonies booked just three weeks out, so don't count it out if your timing is tight.
What if the weather is bad on the day?

Every package includes a weather-flex re-booking promise. If conditions make your chosen location unsafe or undeniably miserable, we either move to a thoughtfully-chosen plan B (we always have one) or reschedule entirely, at no penalty. Heli packages include premium weather-flex with up to three reschedule windows.
Do you cater to same-sex couples?

Always have, always will. Some of our most-loved ceremonies have been LGBTQ+ elopements. Australia has full marriage equality and our entire team — celebrants, photographers, vendors — works inclusively as standard.
What about legalities for overseas couples?

Marrying in Australia as an overseas couple is straightforward. A Notice of Intended Marriage is lodged with your celebrant at least one month (and up to eighteen months) before the ceremony, and our team walks you through the entire process. We've helped couples from Australia, New Zealand, the US, the UK, Singapore and beyond.

A 30% deposit secures your date. The remaining balance is due 30 days before the ceremony. We accept bank transfer, credit card and international wire. Heli packages have a separate weather-contingency fee held in trust and refunded if not used.

Yes — though we keep numbers gentle. Up to six guests can attend any package without changing the price; up to twelve with a small modification. Beyond that, we still help — it just becomes less of an "elopement" and more of a micro-wedding, which we also love.
"The Signature package felt like it was written for us. We didn't ask for one customisation — and yet it landed like a tailored suit. That's the trick of really good design."

Since 2016, Eloping Weddings has helped couples leave the noise of the big traditional wedding behind and stand still in wild, sun-drenched beauty. What began in New Zealand now continues across Australia. Every elopement is thoughtfully designed, calmly run, and beautifully remembered.
Quiet I do's, from New Zealand to Australia.

Eloping Weddings was not born in a corporate planning suite. It was born on a wild, wind-swept headland in New Zealand in 2016, when our founder stood with a couple who had abandoned a guest list of two hundred people to marry in near silence. There were no microphones, no white chair covers, no timelines. Just two voices, almost lost in the sea breeze, saying words they actually meant.

We realised then that an elopement is not a compromised wedding. It is not a secondary choice for those who want to save money or avoid family drama, though it often accomplishes both. It is a deliberate, premium choice to place the actual love story back at the centre of the wedding day. Since then, we have quietly walked alongside couples from New Zealand, Australia, the UK, the USA and Singapore, designing days that belong entirely to them.

We have coordinated helicopter landings on clifftops that look like the edge of the world, arranged quiet hinterland exchanges under flowering gums, and stood as the legal witnesses on deserted golden beaches. Our purpose is simple: to carry every logistical thread so that when the moment comes, you can simply stand still in it.

We believe a wedding day should feel like a memory, not a theatrical production. Our couples don't perform for a crowd or walk to a choreographer's beat. We design the schedule around your natural rhythm, leaving space for a quiet coffee at sunrise, a slow walk along the sand, and long pauses to simply breathe together before you say your vows.

Australia has been blessed with some of the most stunning wedding settings on Earth. We do not need artificial decorations, arches of imported flowers, or satin drapes. Whether it is a windswept coastal headland, the green hush of the hinterland, or the quiet shore of a secret beach, we let the ancient landscape speak for itself and hold your ceremony beautifully.

We do not ask you to deal with multiple vendors, manage spreadsheets, or worry about weather contingencies. From the celebrant, the photographer and the legal paperwork to the helicopter pilot, the florist and the dinner reservation, we orchestrate every single detail with quiet precision, so you are entirely free to enjoy being in love.
Meet the souls who protect your day.

We are a small, tight-knit collective of planners, celebrants, photographers and pilots who share a common belief: that weddings should be simple, honest and incredibly beautiful. We don't run a factory-style elopement agency. We only host two elopements per week across Australia, ensuring every couple receives our full focus, weather-contingency devotion and quiet presence.

Our celebrants are chosen for their warmth and storytelling, not just their licence. Our photographers are masters of quiet light, trained to document your day without making you pose or perform. And our helicopter pilots are among the most experienced coastal flyers in Australia, capable of finding secret, windswept ridges where the rest of the world completely disappears.
We believe that an elopement is only as good as the people who hold it. Over the years, we have built a highly exclusive network of local partners who treat your day with the reverence it deserves.
Highly skilled pilots who navigate the coastal headlands, hinterland ridges and secret valleys of Eastern Australia with flawless precision and safety.
Artisanal floral designers who build your bouquet by hand using seasonal, native blooms gathered from local gardens and growers that very morning.
Officiants chosen specifically for their calm presence, soft voices, and ability to craft a legal ceremony that feels deeply authentic to who you are as a couple.
Hair and make-up artists who specialise in natural, elegant styles designed to look stunning in the clear Australian sunlight and withstand the coastal breeze.
Culinary artists who prepare intimate post-ceremony dinners using locally sourced produce and fresh ocean catch, paired with award-winning Australian wine.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: Eloping_Weddings_Australian
item.content:encoded:
Your privacy matters to us at Eloping Weddings.

This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, subscribe to "The slow newsletter," or book an elopement package with us.

1. Information We Collect

  • Personal Details: When you submit an inquiry or book a package, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and specific details about your elopement plans.
  • Newsletter Data: If you join our slow newsletter, we collect your email address to send you our monthly updates.
  • Usage Data: We may collect non-identifiable data (such as IP addresses and browser types) through cookies to analyze website traffic and improve our user experience.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To communicate with you regarding your inquiry, booking process, and elopement planning.
  • To coordinate seamlessly with our trusted third-party vendors (such as celebrants, photographers, and helicopter operators) who are required for your wedding day.
  • To send you our monthly newsletter (only if you have explicitly opted in). You can unsubscribe from this at any time using the link at the bottom of our emails.

3. Sharing Your Information

We respect your privacy and will never sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We only share necessary details with our direct partners and vendors who are actively involved in safely and beautifully orchestrating your elopement.

4. Data Security

We implement standard, industry-appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, please note that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you, ask for corrections, or request the deletion of your data. To exercise these rights, please reach out to our team.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us.

item.title: Terms & Conditions
item.dc:creator: Eloping_Weddings_Australian
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to Eloping Weddings.

These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our website and the booking of our elopement packages across Aotearoa New Zealand. By accessing our website or booking our services, you agree to comply with and be bound by these terms.

1. Bookings & Payments

  • A non-refundable deposit is required to secure your elopement date and chosen package.
  • The remaining balance must be paid in full at least 30 days prior to your scheduled elopement date.
  • All prices are listed in NZD and are subject to change without prior notice, though confirmed bookings will retain their agreed-upon rate.

2. Cancellations & Rescheduling

  • We understand that life happens. If you need to reschedule, we will do our best to accommodate your new date, subject to vendor and location availability. Additional fees may apply.
  • Cancellations made within 60 days of the elopement date may result in a forfeiture of the full payment, as vendors and permits are secured well in advance.
  • Helicopter flights and certain locations are weather-dependent. In case of extreme weather, we will work with you to find an alternative location, adjust the timeline, or reschedule to a backup date if possible.

3. Photography & Usage Rights

  • We proudly quietly orchestrate and cinematically remember your special day. By booking with us, you grant Eloping Weddings the right to use selected images and videos for promotional purposes, including our website, social media, and marketing materials.
  • If you prefer to keep your elopement entirely private, please let us know in writing prior to your wedding day, and we will respect your privacy.

4. Liability & Responsibility

  • Eloping Weddings acts as a coordinator for your elopement, working with trusted independent vendors (celebrants, photographers, helicopter operators). We are not liable for any delays, accidents, or breaches of contract by third-party vendors.
  • Couples are responsible for obtaining their own travel insurance and ensuring they meet all legal requirements for marriage in New Zealand.

5. Governing Law

These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of New Zealand. Any disputes relating to these terms and conditions will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New Zealand.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns regarding these Terms and Conditions, please reach out to us via our Contact page.
